thread:
maria: Announcing GA for Private 2.0 (VPC + on-prem) — released today. Highlights: FIPS-compliant crypto mode, KMS/HSM integrations, per-token audit logs, offline air-gapped installer, and a new Helm chart + image bundles for airgap installs. Docs + upgrade checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-2.0 (internal).

maria: Rollout plan: tomorrow 09:00 PT we begin staged enablement for current Private customers who opted into upgrades. Dedicated and on-prem customers must schedule a migration window; see the schedule in the Console -> Admin -> Migrations.

kevin: Awesome — any breaking changes? runtime/agent versions required?

maria: No breaking surface for the public API. Runtime agent must be bumped to v2.0.0 for KV cache improvements and FIPS mode flags. See upgrade snippet:
```
helm upgrade redwood-private ./chart --set image.tag=2.0.0
# or for airgap
kubectl apply -f airgap-bundle-2.0.0.yaml
```

raj: Security note — FIPS mode requires enabling crypto.mode=fips in /etc/redwood/config.yaml and provisioning an HSM/KMS; audited keys must be rotated per policy. Also audit-log retention defaults to 90 days; contact compliance to extend.

sophie: Support will publish runbooks and an incident playbook for upgrades by EOD. Can we get a staging cluster image seed so we can run through a mock migration?

maria: Olivia in infra will share a staging seed. @olivia can we share the link to the staging cluster images?

olivia: shared, link posted in #eng-infra. Tagging deploy-bot for the staging deploy job.

deploy-bot: staging deployment for private-2.0 initiated at 2026-03-14T22:12:04Z. All checks passing.

kevin: Any customer-facing compliance materials for sales/security reviews?

maria: Yes — attached: internal/compliance/private-2.0-cert-matrix.pdf and a one-pager for customers. Sales template in /sales/templates/private-upgrade-email.md.

raj: One more ask — can we schedule a quick 30m security briefing for SOC2 and FINRA customers? Prefer next Tue.

sophie: I can run the session. Scheduling poll in #calendar.

maria: Thanks all. If you see any regressions in staging, raise a ticket with priority P0 and tag #eng-oncall. Chat threads for migration requests should go to #private-onboarding.

kevin: :party-parrot: congrats team!
